column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for the equipment. PK. Example: PE593707.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment type. FK to EquipmentType.EquipType.
TEXT. Model name of the equipment. **NULL means no model name provided.**. Example: Model-925.
TEXT. Name of the equipment manufacturer. **NULL means no manufacturer provided.**. Example: Lee, Meyers and Hamilton.
BIGINT. Number of years the equipment has been in service. Example: 4.
REAL. Utilization percentage of the equipment. Example: 53.
REAL. Reliability index of the equipment. Example: 97.8.
